name: returns the longest matching stored prefix
test:
cache = PrefixCache()
short = [1, 2]
cache.store(short, 'short')
cache.store([1, 2, 3], 'long')
short.append(99)
assert cache.lookup([1, 2, 3, 4]) == (3, 'long')
assert cache.lookup([1, 2, 8]) == (2, 'short')
assert cache.lookup([9]) is None

input: replace then remove one exact prefix
